text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Was something missing? Some part of me...?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
As I am right now,
it's not enough. I have 
to go far, far ahead so no one can beat 
me...!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Our promise from that day…… I won't let
it 
end here!
choice_data_list: ...Then I have to get stronger too!
...Then I have to get stronger too!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
choice_data_list: ...Then I've got to get stronger too!
...Then I've got to get stronger too!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
choice_data_list: Step by step... let's start walkin...
Making you stronger is my duty, af...
Making you stronger is my job, aft...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
—You're right.
We'll get stronger together 
and overcome every obstacle, one by one.
choice_data_list: Step by step... let's start walkin...
Making you stronger is my duty, af...
Making you stronger is my job, aft...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I've always lived that way. Ever since 
that day... when that breathtaking view 
was etched into my heart.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Next time,
I can definitely overcome it. I 
won't... lose anymore!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
choice_data_list: As the one who stands beside you— ...
As the one who stands beside you— ...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
choice_data_list: As the one standing beside you, le...
As the one standing beside you, le...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
To your guidance...
I will answer with all 
my might!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
So…… I look forward to working with you 
from here on out, too!
